extractions.value: First documented case of SPS associated with histologically proven thymoma. Patient developed ocular myasthenia gravis after thymectomy which resolved spontaneously. ANA positive at 1:40 (nucleolar pattern). Clinical myokymia present in gastrocnemius. High H-reflex to M-wave amplitude ratios (0.38-0.62), high F-wave to M-wave ratio (0.15), high T-reflex amplitudes. Masseter silent period absent. Continuous MUPs abolished under general anesthesia. Symptoms recurred at 14 and 29 months after thymectomy, responding to IVIG each time.
extractions.quote: We report the first documented case of SPS associated with histologically proven thymoma.
